messages:
maya: heads up—customer 'PayFast' on prod is seeing 10-20s p99 for text-generation and occasional 502s. They said they pinned region to us-east but traces show requests hitting eu-west and sa-east in the same minute.
jon: rough timeline?
maya: started ~10:12 UTC, ramped at 10:14. Here's the request id: req_0a1b2c. Dashboard: https://console.redwood.internal/tenants/payfast/requests?from=2026-03-15T10:10&to=2026-03-15T10:20
eli: checked routing logs — our router returned 200 then 500 from different regions for same client session. Looks like client is retrying across regions.
maya: customer SDK config snippet they sent:
```
client = RedwoodClient(
  region='auto',
  retry_strategy='hedged',
  per_attempt_timeout_ms=120,
  backoff_multiplier=1.5,
  max_attempts=3,
)
```
maya: they do not set a preferred region, relying on 'auto'.
jon: that per_attempt_timeout is low. With network jitter, hedged attempts may race different endpoints and cause 'region-snap' behavior. If the SDK marks attempts as failed quickly it will try another endpoint/region.
sanjay: also saw client side DNS TTL very short (5s) in their environment, plus our SDK does a best-effort geo-lookup each attempt -> can flip routing.
jon: proposed quick mitigation: set per_attempt_timeout_ms=500 and set prefer_region='us-east' for that tenant. Also add single-region sticky fallback for 30s.
maya: customer ok to try. I'll relay config change and schedule a test window at 10:45.
eli: can we add server-side protection? maybe honor region-pin header if set, and drop cross-region attempts for 30s after first success.
jon: Agree. Also add a heuristic in SDK: if hedged mode and first attempt succeeds but subsequent attempts hit other regions, cancel them immediately.
maya: for repro I'll run a script that simulates 10 simultaneous clients with per_attempt_timeout 100ms and hedged=true. Will post logs.
support-bot: Ticket INC-20260315-4237 created for PayFast; tagging eng-routing and SDK.
maya: thanks. tagging @jon @eli for follow-ups. :thumbsup: 
jon: will prepare a small SDK patch and a hotfix flag on the server. ETA few hours.
eli: I'll instrument trace sampling to capture more of those cross-region hedged flows.
maya: logging note—please include X-Client-Attempt header in logs so we can correlate.
jon: adding that header in next patch.
maya: last update: customer applied prefer_region and p_timeout=600ms, p99 dropped to 600ms and errors went away. mark as resolved but followed by eng action items.
